notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). Reference for Amazon RDS: subnet groups, creating a Multi-AZ encrypted PostgreSQL instance, parameter groups, read replicas, snapshots and point-in-time recovery, CloudWatch alarms, a Terraform example and troubleshooting.

Medium: following it has the agent run `aws rds`/`aws cloudwatch` commands that create, modify (`--apply-immediately`), promote and restore database instances, copy and delete snapshots, and read the RDS-managed master password via `aws secretsmanager get-secret-value` (SKILL.md:103-105). Acceptable because these are the standard operations for the user's own RDS task under their configured AWS identity, and defaults are security-positive (storage encryption, deletion protection, managed master password, final snapshot). Users should confirm before `aws rds delete-db-snapshot` (SKILL.md:212), `promote-read-replica` (SKILL.md:161) and `modify-db-instance --apply-immediately` (SKILL.md:132-135) against production, and avoid printing the master password in shared logs.

Account ID 123456789012, ARNs, subnet and security-group IDs are placeholders. Related Skills (SKILL.md:360-364) link to sibling skills ../terraform-aws/, ../aws-vpc/, ../aws-iam/, ../aws-cost-optimization/, ../aws-s3/ that do not ship with this skill; they are optional pointers.
